name: Baikonur Site 81
best_known_for: Baikonur's Proton complex: Proton 1, Salyut 1, Mir and ISS modules, Mars and Luna probes
credit: Facts from the Wikipedia articles on Baikonur Cosmodrome Site 81 and the lists of Proton launches, and Encyclopedia Astronautica's Baikonur LC81/23 and LC81/24 pages.
